title: Write IP-safe scenario comparisons (Without vs With)
story: As a technical decision-maker, I want concrete scenarios comparing environments without and with DaemonCore so that the category difference becomes obvious without exposing internals.
description: Create 2–3 concise scenarios using a strict two-column structure (Without DaemonCore / With DaemonCore) focused on outcomes and constraints, not mechanisms.
acceptance_criteria: Each scenario uses a consistent two-column structure: Without / With.
No implementation detail, no internal module names, no how-it-works sequences.
Language avoids absolutes like '100% controlled' and avoids performance/timeline promises.
